description: This file provides database connection management functions for MongoDB using Mongoose, including establishing connections, retrieving database and collection instances, and checking connection status.

methods.name: connectDB
methods.description: Establishes a connection to MongoDB using environment variables for configuration, sets connection options, and logs connection events.

methods.name: getDb
methods.description: Returns an active MongoDB database instance, establishing a connection if necessary.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Retrieves a MongoDB collection by name or list of candidate names, returning the first existing collection or defaulting to the first candidate.

methods.name: isDbConnected
methods.description: Checks if Mongoose is currently connected to MongoDB.
